name: Neon Channel Product Customizer Free
author: vertim

sections.description:
Neon Channel Product Customizer (NCPC) is a powerful and intuitive WordPress/WooCommerce plugin that lets you create fully custom neon signs and letters directly in your online store. Designed for sign makers and online shops, it simplifies the design process, streamlines production, and helps you boost sales by offering a seamless custom sign experience for your customers.

Supported Sign Types

  • LED Neon Signs – Flexible, vibrant neon tubes for eye-catching displays.
  • Acrylic Letter Signs – Premium 2D/3D letters with optional backlighting.
  • Metal Letter Signs – Elegant metallic finishes for professional signage.
  • Wooden Signs – Rustic and natural wood materials for a classic look.
  • Graphic with Text Signs – Fully customizable signs combining graphics and text for unique designs.

Why Choose Neon Channel Product Customizer?

  • Live Design Preview – Show customers realistic previews of their custom neon signs with multiple materials, colors, and font options.
  • Dynamic Pricing – Automatically calculate prices based on material, size, and selected options.
  • Streamlined Production – Generate detailed specifications for your workshop, including SVG exports for precise cutting.
  • Mobile-Friendly Interface – Fully responsive design ensures customers can design on any device.
  • Boost Sales & Engagement – Interactive customization keeps customers engaged and increases conversions.

Features

  • Custom TTF fonts support
  • Custom colors palette for limited colors usage
  • Definition of customization sizes and number of characters per text
  • Translation ready
  • Shortcode available
  • Design data in cart
  • Pricing calculation
  • Automatic calculation of text height
  • Responsive and user-friendly

Premium features

  • Multiple fonts and color options per sign.
  • Custom graphics and icon uploads.
  • Material options: metal, acrylic, wood, and LED.
  • Automated production emails with detailed specs.
  • SVG file exports for accurate production.
  • Real-time cost calculation based on material and size.
  • Volumetric shipping estimation.
  • Unlimited design submissions from customers.
  • Request a quote
  • RGB Visualisation
  • Background Previews

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • Woocommerce version 7.4 or greater
  • PHP version 7.0 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working

Automatic installation (easiest way)

To do an automatic install of Neon Channel Product Customizer Free, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.

In the search field type “Neon Channel Product Customizer Free” and click Search Plugins. Once you have found it you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.

Manual installation

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  1. Download `neon-channel-product-customizer-free.zip`
  2. Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  3. Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  4. Select `neon-channel-product-customizer-free.zip` from your computer
  5. Click ‘Install Now’
  6. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

Using FTP

  1. Download `neon-channel-product-customizer-free.zip`
  2. Extract the `neon-channel-product-customizer-free` directory to your computer
  3. Upload the `neon-channel-product-customizer-free` directory to the `/wp-content/plugins/` directory
  4. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to install a WordPress plugin.

Updating

You can use automatic update to update the plugin safely.
